rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for broccoli.

example.english: We usually steam broccoli at home.
example.traditional: 西蘭花我屋企通常蒸熟嚟食。
example.jyutping: sai1 laan4 faa1 ngo5 uk1 kei2 tung1 soeng4 zing1 suk6 lai4 sik6

rows.note: A less common alternative name for the same vegetable, used instead of 西蘭花 in some contexts.

example.english: Broccoli goes really well with beef when stir-fried.
example.jyutping: baak3 gaa1 lei6 caau2 ngau4 juk6 gei2 gaap3
